messages:
maria: Heads-up — preparing TS SDK v3.0.0 which changes the routing option shape (breaking). We need to sync console banners + API compatibility before publish. This affects routing, default fallback behavior, and quota tagging for telemetry.

sam: ugh — what specifically is changing? any migration path?

maria: Old option was `routingPolicy: { type: 'weighted' | 'latency', weights?: Record<string, number> }`. New shape is `routing: { strategy: 'WEIGHTED' | 'LATENCY', variants: Array<{id:string, weight:number}> }` (enum names uppercased, field rename, list instead of map). Also we now send `route_choice` telemetry with the chosen variant id in every request, which will affect analytics dashboards.

kevin: Renaming + shape change will break users who construct objects in TS using the old interface. Can we add a one-release compat shim that accepts both shapes?

lina: I can add a compat layer in the SDK: if `routingPolicy` present, translate to `routing`. But that will mask the breaking change and might delay console/Audit changes. We should also emit a `console.deprecation` telemetry event so we can show a deprecation banner per-customer.

maria: Agreed on deprecation telemetry. Plan proposal: 1) v3.0 rc published with compat shim enabled behind `compatMode: 'v2'` default for RC, 2) Console will show a per-account banner for routes using `routingPolicy` (we'll surface the `console.deprecation` event), 3) Remove shim in v4.0.

sam: That sounds reasonable. For Dedicated customers we should add an opt-in toggle in Console to keep `compatMode` on for their org for an extra 3 months. Ops needs a rollout path.

kevin: Also note quotas: previously we tagged telemetry with `quota_bucket` derived from model name. With v3 we want `quota_bucket` to include `route_variant` when present. Need to update billing/usage pipelines.

lina: Migration snippet for docs (old -> new):
```ts
// old
client.request({
  model: 'redwood-large',
  routingPolicy: { type: 'weighted', weights: { a: 70, b: 30 } }
})

// new
client.request({
  model: 'redwood-large',
  routing: { strategy: 'WEIGHTED', variants: [{ id: 'a', weight: 70 }, { id: 'b', weight: 30 }] }
})
```

maria: Docs should include a script to transform JSON manifests. Lina, can you add a `migrate-routing` CLI that scans configs and emits warnings?

lina: Yep, I'll add a small node script and a `--dry-run` mode. Also propose we add a `console` UX change: in the API routes table show a small pill `compat:v2` if the shim was used. That helps sales/support spot which customers need outreach.

sam: Telemetry question — will `route_choice` be included in GDPR-sensitive logs? We need to ensure it isn't personally identifiable.

kevin: `route_choice` is just the variant id (string). No PII. But for privacy we should hash variant ids in analytic exports unless the customer has given consent for detailed exports. Add a flag `telemetry.route_choice_clear` default false.

maria: Good call. Add to the release notes and the RC changelog. Also coordinate with eng-platform so the API accepts both payload shapes for RCs. We should also add an API compatibility test in the CI that sends both payloads to the same route.

release-bot: npm: @redwood/ts-sdk v3.0.0-rc.1 published — 1760304200

sam: Nice. Can we gate GA until console banners + quota pipeline change are deployed? Prefer GA after a one-week RC period and a migration run across flagged accounts.

maria: Yes — target GA in two weeks if no major issues. I'll open a short runbook for oncall to revert the shim on a per-org basis if something explodes.

kevin: One more: update changelog entry to mention the breaking rename for `routingPolicy -> routing`, the telemetry addition (`route_choice` + `console.deprecation`), and the `quota_bucket` change. Also add a code mod script example.

lina: I'll draft the SDK PR and the code-mod. Will cc @maria when the PR is ready for review.

maria: Thanks — I'll coordinate with product to get the console banner design and with billing to update the quota pipeline. :thumbsup:

sam: ping me when rc collects some telemetry so I can run dashboards to compare pre/post.

release-bot: CI: compatibility-test job passed for v3.0.0-rc.1 — 1760304275
